title: Regret at being self-taught and not finishing musical education
summary: Basie says he played by ear, was hard-headed, and now wishes he had finished his musical education.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Not such a great musician at all.
You really do think that, don't you?
Well, I played a lot but (inaudible), just by ear. Just ear.
Which (inaudible) found out later on down that that's not it. (Inaudible) what it's all about. Musical education.
So in other words, you sound as if you're sorry that you didn't --
Sure, I wished I hadn't have been so
hard-headed and determined not to, that -- and really finished.
Yes, yes. Oh, I really do. And I could see how important it is. I'm very limited. (Inaudible).
